name: .308 Cal-196gr Hammer Hunter®
note: Recommended Use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "We designed this bullet for the guys who have standard 1-10″ twist barrels that feel better shooting a bullet in the 200gr class with a good bc. The 196gr Hammer Hunter™ has the classic nose design of the other Hammer Hunters™ but with a shortened boat tail and longer baring surface in order to get the weight up. This one will be a great normal to long range hunting bullet." The product name says 196 gr; the specification says 193 gr.
